description: This file defines the interface for the Media Pipeline IPC in the Rialto client, including factory creation, media control methods, and IPC communication with the Rialto server.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IMediaPipelineIpc instances.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineIpc
classes.description: Interface defining IPC methods for media pipeline control.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the IMediaPipelineIpcFactory instance.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineIpc
methods.description: Creates a new IMediaPipelineIpc object with specified client and video requirements.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to the server backend, returning a source ID.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source from the server backend by source ID.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Checks if all sources are attached.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads media into the pipeline with specified type, MIME type, and URL.

methods.name: setVideoWindow
methods.description: Sets the position and size of the video window.

methods.name: haveData
methods.description: Notifies that data has been written to shared memory.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the playback position in nanoseconds.
